description_for_model: Flypost Post provides authenticated write access to parse and publish real estate events from natural language descriptions. Browser origins (post.goflypost.com, app.goflypost.com) MUST use Firebase authentication (Authorization: Bearer <firebase_id_token>). Machine/server-to-server callers use static write token via x-flypost-write-token header or Bearer token. The proxy maps tokens to brokerageId. Truth-writing endpoints (presence check-ins, feedback submissions) are restricted to presence.goflypost.com origin and NOT accessible via this surface.
description_for_human: Publish real estate events like open houses from natural language descriptions (authentication required).
